report.title: installer one-liner masks fetch failures
report.evidence: Current generator line 500 and README line 71 emit `fetch -qo - ... | sh`. Executed `sh -c '(exit 7) | sh; printf ...'` returned `pipeline_rc=0`, confirming the failed producer is masked by `sh`.
report.suggested_fix: Fetch to a temporary file and execute it only after a successful fetch, using `fetch ... && sh ...` with cleanup.

report.title: cwd-relative hook overrides the embedded trusted hook
report.evidence: Lines 33-34 derive HOOK_SRC from `$0`, and lines 133-145 prefer and install that file. A generated installer piped through `sh -s` from a work directory copied and executed a decoy at `../rc.d/pfblockerng_repo_generate.sh`: `installer_rc=0`, `decoy_marker=executed-as-uid=501`, `installed_hook_is_decoy=True`, and `done_reported=True`. README line 68 directs users to run the command as root.
report.suggested_fix: Make published installers always emit the embedded hook; permit HOOK_SRC only in an explicitly identified checkout invocation.

report.title: stale marker lets failed conf regeneration pass
report.evidence: The hook leaves an existing conf unchanged on detection failure, while line 180 checks only whether the old marker exists. With a marked ce-2.7 conf and no version file, the executed installer produced `installer_rc=0`, `detection_warning=True`, `stale_conf_unchanged=True`, `stale_url_reported=True`, `pkg_update_called=True`, and `done_reported=True`.
report.suggested_fix: Use a strict generation path that writes a newly generated conf to a temporary file and atomically replaces the existing conf only on successful detection and emission.

report.title: payload verification succeeds when pkg info fails
report.evidence: Lines 305-314 derive `_missing` through a pipeline without checking `pkg info -l` separately. An executed pkg double returned 9 for that query, but output showed `installer_rc=0`, `info-failed-rc=9`, `info_call_logged=True`, and `done_reported=True`.
report.suggested_fix: Capture `pkg info -l` into a temporary file and fail with exit 6 if that command fails before processing its output.
